instructions:
### ROLE ###
You maintain a small, growing set of CONCEPT SCHEMES (entity categories) for a knowledge registry built from cybersecurity incident reports. A group of entities extracted from several reports has just been found to be close to each other and far from every existing scheme. Decide whether the group is a genuinely new scheme or an alias of an existing one, and name it.

### EXISTING SCHEMES ###
- Email Address: A unique electronic mail identifier used to send, receive, or route digital messages across networks.
- Country: A distinct sovereign nation, state, or territorial body with its own government and defined geographical borders.
- Threat Actor: An individual or organized group responsible for conducting malicious cyber activities, espionage, or computer network attacks.
- Domain Name: A human-readable string identifying a specific network address or resource within the Domain Name System.
- IP Address: A numerical label assigned to a device or interface connected to a computer network using the Internet Protocol.
- Malware Family: A malicious software program, variant, or family designed to compromise systems, exfiltrate data, or disrupt computer operations.
- Software Vulnerability: A security flaw or weakness in software, hardware, or system architecture that can be exploited by threat actors.
- Software Product: A legitimate software program, application, operating system, or utility used for computational tasks or system administration.

### THE GROUP ###
Each line is one entity with the description written at extraction time:
- Держспецзв'язку [government body] — The State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection of Ukraine.
- Національний координаційний центр кібербезпеки [government body] — The national coordinating body for cybersecurity under the NSDC of Ukraine (NCSCC).
- РНБО України [government body] — The National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine.
- Кабінет Міністрів України [government body] — The highest body of executive power in Ukraine.
- Національного банку України [government body] — The central bank of Ukraine responsible for monetary policy and financial system stability.
- Національна академія СБ України [government body] — A Ukrainian higher military educational institution subordinate to the Security Service of Ukraine.
- Департамент контрозвідки Служби безпеки України [government body] — The counterintelligence department of the Security Service of Ukraine.
- Служба безпеки України [government body] — The state security and intelligence agency of Ukraine, also known as SBU.
- Служба безпеки України [government body] — The main intelligence and security agency of the Ukrainian government.

### RULES ###
- A scheme is a KIND of entity (e.g. "Hacker group", "Malware family", "Software product", "Government body", "Internet domain", "Country"), never a role in an incident and never a single entity.
- Return `"verdict": "alias-of"` with `"target"` set to an existing scheme's label when the group is the same kind as that scheme (different wording, same meaning). Judge by MEANING of the descriptions, not by surface words.
- Return `"verdict": "new"` when no existing scheme covers the group. Then give:
  - `prefLabel`: a short English noun phrase, 1–3 words, singular, Title Case (e.g. "Malware Family").
  - `definition`: one sentence, at most 25 words, stating what belongs to the scheme, general enough to hold across reports.
  - `altLabels`: 0–3 alternative English labels.
- If the group mixes clearly different kinds, name the kind of the MAJORITY and list the minority entity names in `outliers`.
- If uncertain between alias and new, prefer `new`: an extra scheme can be merged later; a wrong merge cannot be undone cheaply.

### OUTPUT ###
A single raw JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary:
{ "verdict": "new" | "alias-of", "target": "<existing label or null>", "prefLabel": "...", "definition": "...", "altLabels": [...], "outliers": [...] }
text: Decide and name the group now.
response: {"verdict": "new", "target": null, "prefLabel": "Government Agency", "definition": "An official administrative body, department, ministry, or public institution operating under the authority of a sovereign state or government.", "altLabels": ["Government Body", "Government Organization", "State Agency"], "outliers": []}
